policy.name: Madhya Pradesh MSME Development Policy, 2025 (Department of MSME, GoMP)
policy.order_no: Department of MSME, Government of Madhya Pradesh

zone_lookup: Not confirmed. The companion MP Investment Promotion Scheme 2025 for LARGE units (NSWS copy, Annexure A 'List of Priority Blocks', doc p.53) uses Priority Blocks for a geographical multiple. Whether and how the MSME Policy 2025 uses priority blocks for MSMEs could not be confirmed from the official text.

schemes.name: Industrial Development Subsidy (units with P&M investment up to Rs 10 crore)
schemes.clause: MP MSME Development Policy 2025, clause 7.1.1 and 7.1.2(i), Annexure-2
schemes.notes: Official text: new units with P&M up to Rs 10 crore get 40% of eligible investment (P&M, building capped at 100% of P&M, and items in clause 17(vi)) in 4 annual instalments; above Rs 10 crore, up to 40% as investment promotion assistance over 7 years per the Annexure-2 formula, which equals 40% up to Rs 50 crore eligible investment and tapers above. Women/SC/ST owners get +2% a year for 4 years, exporters +2-3%; multipliers for exports, employment, priority blocks and FDI raise it further (not modelled, so the estimate is a floor). Expansion/diversification of existing units counts on the additional investment.

schemes.name: Quality certification reimbursement (domestic: ISO, BIS, BEE, ISI, FPO, AGMARK)
schemes.notes: Official text: 100% of quality certification spend (ISO/BIS/BEE/ISI/FPO/AGMARK), up to Rs 20 lakh in total during the policy. Export-market certification: 50% up to Rs 50 lakh (7.2(ii)).

schemes.name: Interest subsidy - apparel and made-ups units (P&M above Rs 5 crore)
schemes.notes: Official text: apparel and made-ups units with more than Rs 5 crore in P&M get 5% interest subsidy on term loans for plant and machinery for 7 years; no yearly ceiling stated.

schemes.name: Interest subsidy - pharmaceutical / medical device units (P&M above Rs 5 crore)
schemes.notes: Official text: pharmaceutical / medical device makers with more than Rs 5 crore in P&M get 5% interest subsidy on term loans for 5 years, up to Rs 100 lakh a year. (Earlier secondary sources attributed this to textiles.)

schemes.name: Green industrialization assistance (pollution control, waste management)
schemes.notes: Official text: 50% of spend on waste management, pollution control devices, health & safety equipment and water conservation, up to Rs 50 lakh for units with P&M up to Rs 10 crore and Rs 250 lakh above that. The lower cap is used.

other_benefits: Unverified (secondary): inland freight for exporters at 50% up to Rs 40 lakh/yr for 5 years; testing lab 50% up to Rs 20 lakh; green industrialization (waste management, pollution control, water conservation) at 50% up to Rs 50 lakh per unit, and CETP for 5+ MSMEs up to Rs 100 lakh; patent 100% up to Rs 10 lakh
unverifiable: Verified against the official MP MSME Development Policy 2025 (mpmsme.gov.in), supplied by the client. In force from 24-02-2025 until amended or replaced; the implementing MP MSME Promotion Scheme 2025 has not been read.
Multipliers (exports, employment, priority blocks, FDI) and the extra 2-3% for women/SC/ST owners and exporters are not modelled, so subsidy estimates are a floor.
Above Rs 50 crore eligible investment the Annexure-2 formula tapers below 40%; such units are left out.
No electricity duty or SGST reimbursement for MSMEs in this policy.
